items.text:
Hello from Hetal's kitchen 👋

Heth Spices is a homemade masala brand from Mumbai. We grind in small batches, every pack is ground the week you order it, and there are no added preservatives. Ever.

19 masalas, from everyday Garam Masala to Pav Bhaji, Chaas and Tea Masala, each marked J (Jain) or N.J (Non-Jain) so you always know what's in your kitchen.

Ordering takes a minute:
1️⃣ Tap the menu link in our bio
2️⃣ Pick your masalas and pack size
3️⃣ Send it on WhatsApp and Hetal confirms the rest

Follow along for recipes, masala tips and what's fresh each week 🌶️
